name: tracktime-raycast
title: tracktime
description: Start, stop and edit tracktime timers from Raycast, with a live menu bar clock.
author: trebeljahr

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Timer Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Show the running timer in the macOS menu bar.

preferences.name: titleMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows while a timer runs.

preferences.name: idleTitle
preferences.title: When Nothing Runs
preferences.description: What the menu bar shows while no timer is running.

preferences.name: tickSeconds
preferences.title: Clock
preferences.label: Count the seconds up while a timer runs
preferences.description: Keeps the command loaded so the menu bar clock moves every second. Off shows minutes, refreshed on the command's interval.

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: Idle
preferences.label: Hide the menu bar item when no timer runs
preferences.description: Keeps the menu bar clean; the item reappears on the next start.

commands.name: toggle-timer
commands.title: Start / Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Stop the running timer, or resume the last thing you tracked. Bind it to a hotkey — it never opens a window.

commands.name: timer
commands.title: Timer
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Start or stop tracking — the running timer, favorites and recent work.

commands.name: entries
commands.title: Show All Time
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Browse, continue, edit and delete recent time entries.

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Dashboard
commands.subtitle: tracktime
commands.description: Open the tracktime web app, where reports, invoices and catalog editing live.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Origin of the tracktime server, e.g. https://api.tracktime.example. Empty means the deployed server, or the local dev server under `ray develop`.

preferences.name: webUrl
preferences.title: Web App URL
preferences.description: Origin of the tracktime web app, used for the device-pairing page and Open in Browser. Empty follows the build: the deployed web app in a `ray build`, http://localhost:3392 under `ray develop`.
